prompt:
docs/refunds.md is going: we're cutting the docs folder down. Please move what belongs next to the code into comments in the files it's about.

Input files: README.md, docs/onboarding.md, docs/refunds.md, refunds/__init__.py, refunds/approval.py, refunds/provider.py, tests/__init__.py, tests/test_refunds.py
assertions: No code comment or docstring carries the operational notes: asking #fin-ops about a stalled approval, or the platform team's 90-day key rotation.
Both operational notes are still each in exactly one document.
The PAY-31 four-eyes rule and the idempotency-key reason are each in a code comment or docstring and in no document.
The PAY-31 rule sits at SECOND_APPROVER_THRESHOLD or needs_second_approver, and the idempotency-key reason in or just above send_refund (placement, heuristic).
No added comment or docstring repeats the page's restatements (true for refunds of 500 EUR or more; returns the provider's refund id).
No code changed: every Python file's code is the same apart from comments and docstrings.
Every original comment and docstring is kept word for word, and README.md and docs/onboarding.md lose nothing.
No file was added to the repository.
The reply gives a fate for each of the page's seven claims, including the #fin-ops, sandbox and key-rotation notes.
